name: ledger-reconcile
description: Match bank payouts against open invoices and flag mismatched totals.
when_to_use: Use when a payout or an invoice total does not add up.

name: widget-audit
description: Audit storefront product pages for missing alt text, broken links and stale prices.
when_to_use: Use when a product page looks wrong or before a catalogue launch.

name: garden-planner
description: Plan raised beds, planting dates and crop rotation for a vegetable garden.

name: kettle-descale
description: Step-by-step descaling for an electric kettle with citric acid.
when_to_use: Use when a kettle or coffee machine has limescale.

name: tide-chart-summary
description: Summarise tide tables for a harbour over one week.
when_to_use: Use when someone asks when the tide is high or low.

name: recipe-scaler
description: Scale recipe ingredient amounts up or down for a number of servings.
when_to_use: Use when a recipe must serve more or fewer people.

name: invoice-chaser
description: Write polite reminders for overdue customer invoices.
when_to_use: Use when invoices are past due and need a reminder.

name: meeting-minutes
description: Turn meeting notes into minutes with decisions and owners.
when_to_use: Use after a meeting when notes need writing up.

name: bike-service-log
description: Keep a service log for a bicycle: chain, brakes and tyres.
when_to_use: Use when a bike part was serviced or replaced.

name: brief-writer
description: Write a short brief for a sub-agent task with scope and checks.
when_to_use: Use before handing a task to another agent.

name: forecast-cashflow
description: Project weekly cash flow from invoices and recurring costs.
when_to_use: Use when someone asks what cash will look like later.

name: passport-photo-check
description: Check a photo against passport size and background rules.
when_to_use: Use when a passport or ID photo needs checking.
